scope: Client identity/cache/configuration/redirect boundaries and future synthetic Auth/API provisioning cleanup. No live service execution.

findings.finding: Auth fixture ID was queued for deletion before exact generated-email ownership assertion.
findings.resolution: Validate UUID and generated email before registering the ID for cleanup. Never delete an unexpected returned identity.

findings.finding: Runtime-only key validation occurs after Vite embeds VITE values. A wrongly configured secret would be emitted before rejection. No current secret exposure was found.
findings.required_fix: Reuse safe URL/key validation at Vite startup/build before output; retain browser validation.

findings.finding: Default fetch redirects can forward credential-bearing password/refresh JSON on 307/308 redirects.
findings.required_fix: Reject redirects in the credential-bearing runtime transport.

findings.finding: Expired-session refresh error makes SDK signOut return before local cleanup; an in-memory UI lock disappears on reload.
findings.reproduction: Independent installed-SDK probe and actual browser HTTP fixture both reproduced retained session credentials. Browser case failed in 1.1s with expected false / received true for persisted access_token.
findings.required_fix: Durable logout boundary/local credential removal with old storage writer blocked; reload cannot resurrect prior session, failed fresh login cannot unlock it.

findings.finding: A stale tab may overwrite or delete a fresh session before its storage event arrives, because new login removes the shared logout marker.
findings.reproduction: tests/unit/auth-persistence.test.mjs exercises actual production adapter and interleaved shared Storage.
findings.required_fix: Durable generation pointer plus physically separate credential slots and intent per generation; captured logout client/generation; independent review required.
